question: How many scientists got the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award 2021 for Science & Technology ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The names of 11 scientists__, who received the country’s highest science award Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for science and technology 2021 were announced on 26 September 2021.
 
• The prize is given to Indian scientists below the age of 45 for outstanding research in seven fields—Biology, Chemistry, Environment Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Medicine, and Physics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Award

 
• It is a science award in India.
 
• It is given annually by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR).
 
• It is given for notable and outstanding research, applied or fundamental, in biology, chemistry, environmental science, engineering, mathematics, medicine, and Physics.
 
• The award was named after the founder-director of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar.
 
• It was first awarded in 1958 to Kariamanickam Srinivasa Krishnan for Physical Sciences.
